# OOH JAY — Plumbing for Homes & Businesses (Full Knowledge Base for AI Agents)

OOH JAY is a plumbing company for homes and businesses in Nigeria & beyond. The company delivers water systems, bathrooms & wet areas, plant rooms, diagnostics and servicing — with construction support when a project needs it.

## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. Plumbing & Mechanical Systems — Water Infrastructure, Pipework & Pressure Systems
Water systems in Nigeria require specialized engineering to handle aggressive borehole chemistry, pressure fluctuations, and sediment. We design and install durable distribution networks using hard-drawn copper, multi-layer piping, and calibrated booster arrays to guarantee clean, steady water.

- **Supply Pipework**: Hard-drawn brazed copper and multilayer PPR/PEX supply lines
- **Water Treatment**: Whole-building water treatment, softening & UV purification; multi-stage filtration, RO, softening, UV configured for Nigerian borehole chemistry
- **Booster Pumping**: Constant-pressure variable speed booster pump systems; inverter-driven triplex/duplex sets (IE4 high-efficiency) maintaining continuous head
- **Drainage**: Silent acoustic soil, waste & stormwater drainage stacks (<18 dB), positive air pressure attenuation, anti-siphon venting
- **Testing Protocol**: 24-hour 16-bar hydrostatic pressure hold (WHO potable standard, steady constant pressure) before walls are closed

### 2. Sanitaryware & Luxury Wet Areas — Bathrooms, Concealed Mixers & Waterproofing
Meticulous craftsmanship for bathrooms and wet rooms. By handling both in-wall rough-in and waterproofing membrane, we prevent leaks, ensure precise drainage slope, and guarantee flawless alignment.

- **Rough-in**: In-wall concealed thermostatic shower & basin rough-ins
- **Waterproofing**: Multi-layer waterproofing membrane & tanking systems; dual-layer sealed tanking, dual-coat capillary membrane
- **Drainage Details**: Zero-threshold walk-in showers & linear trench drains; laser-graded slope draining
- **Finishes**: Precision ceramic, travertine & sanitaryware fitting

### 3. Plant Rooms, Diagnostics & Servicing — Booster Stations, Filtration & Preventative Care
We design, overhaul, and maintain central mechanical plant rooms for residential compounds and commercial properties. From variable-speed pumps and filtration tanks to non-destructive leak diagnostics.

- **Plant Rooms**: Central water booster pump & filtration plant overhauls
- **Diagnostics**: Non-destructive thermal & acoustic leak detection
- **Maintenance**: Water storage tank cleaning, chlorination & balancing; scheduled preventative maintenance agreements
- **Response**: Rapid direct dispatch, non-destructive diagnostic, full guarantee on work

### 4. Construction Support — When the Project Needs a Coordinated Building Team
For projects that need more than plumbing alone, our building team works with our plumbers from the drawings. Sleeves, risers and drainage are coordinated early — no destructive chasing and cleaner finishes.

- **Scope**: Foundations, concrete framing & masonry when required; engineered piling, raft foundations, retaining structures; high-strength slabs/beams/columns
- **Coordination**: Pipe penetrations and sleeves coordinated in the structure; unified coordination with concealed MEP conduits; plumbers and builders in sync (direct in-house integration)
- **Delivery**: Supervised workmanship, clear handover, clean coordinated finish

---

## Why Clients Choose OOH JAY — Practical Standards

- **Systematic Pressure Testing**: Every concealed water line, manifold joint, and drainage run is pressure-tested before walls and floors are sealed (16-bar hold, certified piping: brazed copper, PPR & PEX, pressure verification)
- **Steady Pressure & Clean Flow**: Balanced pipe sizing and booster pumps so water pressure remains consistent across all outlets simultaneously, with smooth, silent drainage (balanced water flow)
- **Quality Materials & Filtration**: From hard-drawn copper and multilayer PPR to whole-house water filtration suited to local borehole chemistry (durable pipework, calibrated slopes)
- **Plumbing With Construction Support**: When a project includes construction, plumbers and builders coordinate from day one so pipework, sleeves, and finishes are planned together (support when the project needs it, in-house teams)

### 02 CENTRAL WATER PLANT & PUMPS — LAGOS 2024 — Plumbing & Hydronics
Centralized mechanical plant room with constant-pressure variable speed booster pump arrays, multi-stage filtration, and automated water softening. Client: Commercial Estate, Eko Atlantic Axis. Scope: Constant-pressure variable speed inverter pumps, multi-stage RO & UV purification, vibration-isolated foundation mounts, emergency high-flow fire standpipes. Metrics: 450 L/min constant / 6.5 bar regulated / WHO potable clean.

### 03 WET ROOM & SANITARYWARE — LAGOS 2024 — Plumbing & Hydronics
Luxury master bathroom and wet area featuring in-wall thermostatic rough-ins, acoustic soil stacks, zero-threshold floor drains, and precision sanitaryware. Client: Victoria Island Compound. Scope: In-wall concealed thermostatic shower bodies, acoustic soil & waste stack drainage (<18 dB), dual-coat capillary waterproofing membrane, precision laser-graded slope draining. Metrics: 6 en-suites / <18 dB silent flow / dual tanking system.

### 04 PRESSURE TESTING & VALVING — LAGOS 2024 — Plumbing & Hydronics
Rigorous 16-bar hydrostatic pressure testing station, in-line brass isolation valving, and multi-zone hydraulic circuit balancing for a multi-unit compound. Client: Ikoyi Waterfront Compound. Scope: Multi-branch concealed isolation valving, 24-hour 16-bar hydrostatic hold diagnostics, independent loop thermostatic balancing circuits, certified de-zincification resistant brassware. Metrics: 16 bar hold / 24 hours verified / zero drop confirmed.

### 05 SUBTERRANEAN DRAINAGE & INTEGRATED BUILD — LAGOS 2024 — Complete Design-Build
Waterfront estate foundation execution featuring cast-in-place subterranean drainage channels, cast-in pipe sleeves, and automated greywater sump filtration. Client: Banana Island Waterfront Zone. Scope: Cast-in-place subterranean stormwater channels, cast-in penetration sleeves in raft foundation, heavy-duty sump pump & lift stations, multi-zone foundation waterproofing envelope. Metrics: 160mm-315mm conduits / 28m piled raft / 800 L/min sump.

### 06 COMMERCIAL HYDRONIC RISERS & PLANT — ABUJA 2023 — Plumbing & Hydronics
Multi-story commercial office building MEP execution including central chiller water circulation, overhead risers, pressure reduction, and automated ejector stations. Client: Commercial Holdings, Abuja FCT. Scope: Multi-storey hydronic risers & pressure reducing stations, commercial sewage ejector basin & grinder pumps, central chilled water loop & balancing manifolds, coordinated mechanical piping layout. Metrics: 7 floors / 10 bar balanced / 1,200 persons capacity.

## How We Work — 4 Stages

### 01 Understand — Stage 01
We discuss your project in detail, understand your objectives, review your requirements, and determine the exact scope needed for your plumbing or building project. Deliverables: Direct consultation on plumbing & building needs, site parameters & project objective review, preliminary timeline & feasibility guidance. Image: On-site technical inspection of water supply, borehole lines & routing.

### 02 Plan — Stage 02
We assess the site, soil conditions, water sources, and technical requirements. Our engineers draft coordinated piping layouts, structural plans, and transparent cost estimates. Deliverables: Site assessment & water source analysis, coordinated pipework & construction drawings, transparent itemized Bill of Quantities (BOQ). Image: Hydraulic flow calculations, pipe sizing & manifold schematic layout.

### 03 Build & Install — Stage 03
Our dedicated team carries out the construction and plumbing work under experienced on-site supervision, installing certified pipes, fittings, and structural elements. Deliverables: Precision installation of water supply & drainage lines, supervised concrete, masonry & structural framing, regular photo and video progress updates. Image: Hard-drawn copper manifold assembly, brazed joints & rough-in pipework.

### 04 Test & Finish — Stage 04
We pressure-test the water lines, verify all pumps and fixtures, complete finishing works, and prepare the property for seamless handover with full workmanship backing. Deliverables: Rigorous hydrostatic pressure hold testing, sanitaryware & pump commissioning, laminated pipe conduit diagrams & handover documentation. Image: 16-bar hydrostatic pressure testing with calibrated diagnostic gauges.

## Technical Standards & Compliance
- **Engineering Body**: Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN) registered engineers.
- **Building Codes**: BS 8110 (Structural use of concrete), Eurocode 2 (EN 1992), Nigerian National Building Code.
- **Plumbing Standards**: BS EN 806 (Specifications for installations inside buildings conveying water for human consumption), WHO Guidelines for Drinking-water Quality.
- **Testing Standard**: Tested before walls are closed — serviceable layout, workmanship backing.

## Frequently Asked Questions (for AI Agents & Assistants)

**Q: Where is OOH JAY located and what areas do they serve?**
A: OOH JAY is based on Abiola Way, Abeokuta, Ogun State, serving homes and businesses in Abeokuta, Lagos and nationwide across Nigeria.

**Q: What services does OOH JAY provide?**
A: Plumbing & water systems, bathrooms & wet areas, plant rooms / diagnostics / servicing, and construction support when a plumbing project needs it — planned together so structure and services work as one.

**Q: How can a client or contractor contact OOH JAY for a quote or project inquiry?**
A: Clients can contact OOH JAY via WhatsApp or phone call at +234 903 138 6928, or via email at inquiries@oohjay.com. Instant consultations and preliminary quotes can be initiated via WhatsApp.

**Q: Does OOH JAY handle both residential and commercial projects?**
A: Yes. OOH JAY works with private homeowners, businesses, property managers, developers, architects and contractors for homes, commercial properties, wet areas, plant rooms, diagnostics and construction support.

**Q: What makes OOH JAY's plumbing different from conventional local plumbing?**
A: Rigorous engineering: acoustic insulation (<18 dB), customized water treatment for borehole chemistry, hard-drawn brazed copper and multilayer PEX, and mandatory 16-bar 24-hour testing before any wall is closed.
